# bintables/jfalse

> Fallback branch: jump to {target} if the value in {x} is false (zero).

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/jfalse.pkg)

Used for `{cond!jfalse target}` when the condition's package has no
`jfalse` section of its own (for example a `bool` variable, a call, or
`&&`). Comparisons provide their own, which branch on the flags directly.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{x}
test rax, rax
jz {target}
```

## Used by

[bintables/if](if.md), [bintables/while](while.md)
